interface.longDescription: Create and edit images, videos, music, speech, and sound effects with your getimg account. Use ready-made workflows for professional headshots, photo restoration, stickers, lighting changes, background cleanup, product videos, and UGC ads. Browse your team's media library and reuse previous results as inputs. The existing MCP server provides inline media previews and uploads on supported clients. Sign in to getimg and choose a team when connecting. Generation and editing use that team's credits.
